references.text: David asks for a pure heart, reflecting the idea of inner purity rather than outward actions.
The prophet Isaiah criticizes the people for their false piety and points out that their hearts are far from God.
Jesus teaches that what comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what makes a person unclean.
The author of Hebrews speaks of God's law written on the hearts of God's people as an inner transformation.
